Kolkata’s infrastructure expansion, port operations, and industrial belt across Howrah, Durgapur, and Haldia keep up constant demand for temporary site offices, security guard rooms, and worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and despatches them to Kolkata, Howrah, Salt Lake Sector V, Durgapur, and across West Bengal in 3 to 5 days. If you are looking for a porta cabin in Kolkata for a construction site, industrial plant, or infrastructure project, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

Why Kolkata Buyers Choose SAMAN

Kolkata’s portable cabin market has local fabricators and national marketplace listings — but very few verified manufacturers who publish real specifications and hold third-party quality certifications. SAMAN is a certified manufacturer, not a reseller or aggregator.

What that means for a Kolkata buyer:

  • You get a cabin built to IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section specification — not “mild steel” of unspecified grade
  • Every panel joint is factory-sealed before despatch — not site-sealed after a two-day truck ride in the rains
  • Our MCB board and ELCB are factory-wired and tested — not added by a local electrician after delivery
  • You have a documented ISO-certified supply chain behind your purchase

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications. We also carry NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Our company started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India — supplied from the same Delhi NCR porta cabin manufacturing base that serves North India.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Kolkata: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer’s cost.

Factory-Direct vs Local Fabricators and Marketplace Listings

Most porta cabin enquiries in Kolkata land on one of three kinds of seller: a small local fabricator, a national marketplace listing that forwards your enquiry to whoever bids, or a verified manufacturer. The difference shows up in the cabin you actually receive.

A local fabricator may weld a frame from whatever steel is on hand and seal panels on site after delivery — acceptable for a short-term shed, weaker for a cabin that has to hold up through a Kolkata monsoon. A marketplace listing adds a layer between you and the workshop, so the specification you discussed is not always the specification that gets built. With SAMAN you deal directly with the factory that cuts the steel, presses the panels, and wires the board. The IS 2062 grade, the panel type, the coating, and the electrical fit-out are all confirmed in writing before your cabin enters the build queue — and the same team answers for it after delivery.

Kolkata’s Industrial Zones and Construction Demand

Kolkata and the greater West Bengal industrial corridor drive porta cabin demand across several distinct belts:

Kolkata Port Trust and Haldia Dock Complex (Haldia PIN 721657): Port operations and petrochemical plants at Haldia generate high demand for security cabins at gate entries, portable supervisor offices near loading berths, and QC rooms adjacent to tank farms. The coastal and estuarine environment here makes corrosion-resistant panel and coating choices essential — cement-board panels and epoxy-primed frames perform best.

Durgapur Industrial Zone (PIN 713201): One of West Bengal’s largest steel and engineering industrial clusters. Durgapur Steel Plant expansion projects and associated township development create recurring demand for contractor offices and labour colony blocks. Multi-room modular cabin configurations — 10 to 30 units per project — are common at greenfield expansion sites.

Howrah Engineering Cluster (PIN 711101): Traditional engineering and light manufacturing belt. Small and mid-size firms here need security posts and portable tool stores. Single-room and double-room cabins dominate demand.

Salt Lake Sector V and New Town (Rajarhat) (PIN 700091 / 700157): IT campus construction and large commercial real-estate development in New Town Rajarhat use porta cabins as contractor management offices and visitor entry kiosks during the construction phase.

NH-12 / NH-19 Corridor Projects: Road widening and highway expansion projects running through West Bengal require portable site offices at regular intervals along the corridor — a strong recurring demand type for manufacturer-direct supply.

Kalyani Industrial Area (PIN 741235): Pharmaceutical and engineering plants in Kalyani require security rooms, portable QC cabins, and temporary stores. This cluster is growing with new greenfield plant investments.

SAMAN despatches from Greater Noida via NH-19. Kolkata is 3–5 transit days on a direct flatbed run — the same schedule and dispatch discipline as our Lucknow porta cabin dispatch and our Delhi deliveries.

Porta Cabin Specifications for West Bengal Conditions

Kolkata and West Bengal present specific environmental challenges that affect the right cabin specification: high humidity year-round, heavy monsoon rainfall (June–September), salt-laden air near Haldia and the Sunderbans belt, and temperature swings between summer and winter.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, and powder-coated. For coastal and delta-region sites (Haldia, Kakdwip, Diamond Harbour), we recommend an additional epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before the powder coat finish.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard. Cement-board panels strongly recommended for Haldia port sites, coastal-adjacent locations, and any site with sustained humidity above 85% for six or more months per year.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with controlled drainage slope. Internal false ceiling for thermal comfort. Turbo ventilators for sites without shade cover — Kolkata’s pre-monsoon months (April–May) can push cabin interiors above 38°C without ventilation.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate. For coastal sites, elevated flooring on MS joists recommended to prevent ground moisture migration.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB. Important for West Bengal: our ELCB specification meets the earthing requirements relevant to high-moisture environments.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room modular block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

PUF vs Cement-Board Panels for Kolkata Sites

The single most important specification decision for a West Bengal buyer is the wall panel. Both options sit in the same MS frame; they behave differently in this climate.

50 mm PUF sandwich panel is the standard choice for site offices, security posts, and contractor cabins across Kolkata, Salt Lake, and the New Town construction belt. It insulates well against the pre-monsoon heat and keeps interiors comfortable for office use. For most inland city sites, PUF is the right and more economical call.

Cement-board panel is what we recommend for Haldia port sites, jetty and tank-farm cabins, and any location in the salt-laden coastal and delta belt. Cement board does not soften or delaminate under sustained high humidity the way a lesser panel can, and it pairs well with the additional epoxy primer coat on the frame. If your site sees humidity above 85% for half the year or more, the small extra cost of cement board pays back in cabin life.

Applications in Kolkata and West Bengal

SAMAN porta cabins are used across Kolkata and the wider West Bengal region for:

  • Site offices: Main contractor and sub-contractor offices at metro rail Phase 2 extension sites, East-West corridor projects, and NH expansion work through West Bengal.
  • Port security rooms: Guard cabins at Haldia Dock Complex gate entries, jetty access points, and tank-farm perimeters.
  • Industrial security posts: Factory gate cabins at Durgapur steel plants, Kalyani pharma units, and Howrah engineering works.
  • Labour colony accommodation: Worker accommodation blocks at greenfield plant construction projects in Durgapur, Kalyani, and Rajarhat New Town.
  • Contractor and PMC offices: Portable project management offices at large commercial and IT campus construction projects in New Town, Sector V, and Rajarhat.
  • Portable stores: Locked equipment and material stores at infrastructure corridor project yards across NH-12 and NH-19.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built to specification:

  • Custom room dimensions and multi-room modular layouts
  • Colour choice from standard RAL palette
  • Additional epoxy primer coat for coastal/high-humidity sites
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator for pre-monsoon and summer heat management
  • Internal partition walls
  • Extra door or window units
  • Plumbing provisions for attached toilet or washroom
  • Elevated floor on MS joists for waterlogged or low-lying sites
  • Two-storey stacking where structural load calculations allow

Tell us your site location, environment conditions, required size, and use case. We will confirm the right specification and pricing at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Kolkata — Cost Factors

The price of a porta cabin in Kolkata depends on:

  1. Size: An 8×10 ft single-room cabin is the entry level. A 10×40 ft four-room block is proportionally more expensive.
  2. Panel choice: PUF sandwich panel vs cement-board. Cement board costs slightly more but is the right call for coastal and high-humidity West Bengal sites.
  3. Fit-out level: Structural shell only vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC provision).
  4. Environmental spec: Additional epoxy primer coat, elevated flooring, or turbo ventilators for specific site conditions add to base price.
  5. Quantity: Orders for 5 or more units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.
  6. Transport to district locations: Delivery to sites beyond Kolkata city — Durgapur, Haldia, Kalyani — may have a different freight rate. Confirm when placing your enquiry.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Kolkata, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 or send an enquiry using the form on this page.

Delivery and Installation in Kolkata

We despatch from our Greater Noida factory (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308). Kolkata deliveries travel via NH-19 on flatbed trucks. Standard transit: 3–5 days — the same factory-direct model we run for buyers in other metros, including our porta cabin in Mumbai service.

On delivery, the cabin is placed on your pre-cast RCC plinth. Anchor bolts are secured, panels are checked, and the MCB board is connected. A single-room cabin is ready for occupancy within hours of delivery. A multi-room block typically takes one full day on site.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard to Kolkata city and Howrah. For deliveries to Durgapur, Haldia, Kalyani, or other district locations, confirm the freight rate at order stage.

We do not have a Kolkata showroom or warehouse. Every cabin is manufactured to order at Greater Noida and delivered factory-direct to your site.

Site Readiness Before Your Cabin Arrives

A smooth installation in Kolkata depends on a few things being ready before the flatbed reaches your gate:

  • A level base: a pre-cast RCC plinth is ideal. For low-lying or waterlogged plots common in parts of Howrah and the river belt, plan an elevated plinth or MS-joist support so the cabin floor sits clear of standing monsoon water.
  • Truck access: confirm the approach road and gate can take a flatbed truck and, for multi-room blocks, a crane or hydra for placement. Narrow lanes in older Howrah and central Kolkata areas may need a smaller staging point.
  • A power point: a temporary supply to connect the cabin’s MCB board lets us hand over a fully working unit on the same day.
  • Clear placement marking: mark exactly where the door should face so the cabin is set in its final orientation in one lift.

Share photographs of your site with your enquiry and we will flag anything that needs attention before dispatch.

How Ordering Works and Lead Time to Kolkata

The process from enquiry to a cabin on your Kolkata site is straightforward:

  1. Enquiry: tell us your size, use case, site location, and any environmental concern such as a coastal or low-lying plot.
  2. Specification and quote: we confirm the frame, panel type, coating, electrical fit-out, and a firm price in writing.
  3. Build: once confirmed, your cabin is fabricated and finished at Greater Noida. Build time depends on size and fit-out — a single-room cabin is quicker than a multi-room modular block.
  4. Dispatch and transit: the finished unit travels via NH-19 on a flatbed, reaching Kolkata in 3–5 days.
  5. Installation: placement, anchor-bolting, and electrical connection on your prepared base.

For large orders — a labour colony block or a multi-cabin project at a Durgapur or Kalyani site — share the full scope up front so we can plan the build and staggered dispatch around your project timeline.

GST and Transport Documentation for West Bengal

For buyers in West Bengal, our invoices include 18% GST (HSN 9406 for prefabricated structures). We provide a full tax invoice from SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (GST 09ABBCS7101B1ZT — our Noida registration).

Transport is by road on flatbed trucks. We provide a lorry receipt and despatch note. For buyers who need an e-way bill or specific delivery documentation for their site or plant accounts, confirm this at the time of order and we will ensure the paperwork is in order before the truck departs.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Kolkata

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Howrah, Durgapur, and Haldia?

Yes. We deliver across West Bengal — Kolkata, Howrah, Salt Lake, New Town Rajarhat, Durgapur, Kalyani, and Haldia. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days to Kolkata. Deliveries to Durgapur and Haldia may take an additional day depending on road conditions. Confirm the freight rate for district deliveries at enquiry stage.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Kolkata?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and any site-specific requirements such as elevated flooring or additional corrosion protection. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for an itemised quotation built for your specific site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

How does SAMAN handle West Bengal’s high humidity and monsoon conditions in the cabin build?

Our standard specification includes zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated MS frames, factory-sealed panel joints, and colour-coated GI roofing with a drainage slope. For sites in coastal or delta regions (Haldia, Diamond Harbour, Kakdwip), we recommend an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces and cement-board panels instead of PUF for sustained moisture resistance. These are confirmed at order stage, not added as afterthoughts.

What GST applies to a porta cabin purchase in West Bengal?

Porta cabins are classified under HSN 9406 (prefabricated structures) and attract 18% GST. We issue a full tax invoice from SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (GST registration 09ABBCS7101B1ZT — Noida). We can provide e-way bill documentation and lorry receipt as required for your site accounts. Confirm documentation requirements when placing your order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a government infrastructure project in West Bengal?

Yes. We supply to government contractors and infrastructure project managers. Our NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005) are available for vendor documentation. We can provide ISO certificates, GST registration, PAN, and company incorporation documents as required for government vendor empanelment. Contact us with your project scope and we will confirm what we can supply and on what timeline.

Get a Porta Cabin in Kolkata

To get a porta cabin in Kolkata or anywhere in West Bengal delivered to your site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. You can also send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with full specifications, the right panel recommendation for your site conditions, delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.

Explore our factory-built porta cabin options for the complete product range — sizes, configurations, and applications.
